messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: Perturbation of integer lattice 3x3 plus corners

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "The optimal configuration of 13 points in the unit square, perturbing the 3×3 integer lattice with corners, places points at all four corners and interior points at coordinates (1/3±ε, 1/3), (2/3, 1/3±ε), (1/3±ε, 2/3), (2/3, 2/3∓ε) with ε ≈ 0.093, yielding a minimum triangle area of exactly 1/27 ≈ 0.037037. The perturbation breaks collinear triples along the lattice grid lines while maintaining the minimum-area triangles as those formed by adjacent perturbed points within each 1/3 × 1/3 subcell. No perturbation of the 3×3-plus-corners lattice can exceed this minimum triangle area because the four corner points constrain any interior point to be within distance 2/3 of two adjacent corners, and the ε ≈ 0.093 value is the unique maximizer of the bottleneck."}
